scope: M05 completed shared theme and responsive mechanisms; family adoption follows assigned batches

ownership: Stable read-only TanStack effective atoms are transported through public @lit/context APIs; no copied writable theme snapshot.
One ThemeContextController/model per host; AcmeTheme calls provide() on the base controller.
parentSource supports scope CSS boundary changes even when effective appearance values match.
Document observer resources are shared, with per-binding ancestor/root records and reference counts. Initial discovery and observer installation are synchronous.
Topology/slot/name changes invalidate discovery in a microtask; provider data changes flow synchronously through TanStack.
Root resources and system appearance observation release with the last connected binding.

Native opener bindings follow connected moves/adoption. If still detached at the mutation checkpoint, the binding ends, releases live sources and retains an immutable final effective snapshot for exit. Reopening creates a new binding.
Consumer/controller reconnect obtains fresh parent and document-system sources.
verified: Open and closed slot reassignment without refresh calls
measurementLimits: Wall-clock measurements include RAF scheduling and browser/OS load; no throughput or universal latency threshold claim.

The initial observer-count failure came from Playwright InjectedScript._setupGlobalListenersRemovalDetection. The preserved diagnostic stack identifies it. Final runner initializes Playwright before instrumentation and counts the actual theme observers without hiding unknown observers.
